title: Incudo starting equipment
description: What a character may start with, per class and background (ADR 0087): a file shipped beside a system's system.json, written by a person from the books, and not part of the system format. One entry per element id; an entry is a list of options of which a character takes one: a package of item lines, fixed coins, or a wealth roll. Nothing here is parsed from prose.

system.description: The system this file belongs to, by id.

kind.description: The character kind whose build offers the packages.

step.description: The kind's build step the packages are offered in.

from.description: The kind's pick steps whose answer gives a package, in the order offered: a class step answers with the character's first class only.

equip.description: Element types an item of which is equipped when taken, if a slot it fits is free; everything else is carried.

for.description: The class or background id the package is for.

option.description: One way to start: item lines and coins, or a wealth roll alone.

wealth.description: Roll for the coins instead: the dice in the system's notation, times a multiplier, in a unit.

unlisted.description: What the book lists that no element is: shown beside the option, written nowhere.

line.description: A bundle of items and picks, or a choice of one of several bundles (the book's (a) / (b)).

pick.description: Items the player chooses: from a list of ids, or every element of the types matching a filter in content's supports language, from the books named.

count.description: How many to choose; absent is one.
